about: Celsius Holdings, Inc. develops, processes, manufactures, markets, sells, and distributes functional energy drinks in the United States, North America, Europe, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. The company offers CELSIUS ESSENTIALS, a functional energy drink formulated with aminos; and CELSIUS Hydration, a line of zero-sugar hydration powders featuring electrolytes in various fruit-forward flavors, as well as ready-to-drink energy beverages, on-the-go powder and hydration sticks, and nutrition and wellness products under CELSIUS, Alani Nu, and Rockstar brand names.
